def: {to depress or sink (expectation figuratively, to humiliate, intransitive or transitive)}

occurrences.text: And thou his son, O Belshazzar, hast not humbled thine heart, though thou knewest all this;
And the ten horns out of this kingdom are ten kings that shall arise: and another shall rise after them; and he shall be diverse from the first, and he shall subdue three kings.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
